scene_description: A flat grass clearing with three distinct structures: (1) an oak plank building containing the target potted blue orchid on the back wall, (2) a cobblestone platform with decoy pots (potted dandelion and empty flower pot), and (3) a stone brick structure with a potted poppy inside. Lanterns and torches provide navigation cues, with torches specifically guiding toward the oak building entrance. The scene requires the player to explore multiple locations and identify the correct potted flower among decoys.
task_text: Find the potted blue orchid. There are several buildings and flower pots scattered around the area. Explore inside each structure to locate the potted blue orchid specifically.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at center (0,0,0). Oak plank building at (+5 to +10, 0 to +4, +6 to +11) with 2-wide entrance on south face (z=6). Stone brick structure at (-6 to -3, 0 to +3, +3 to +5) with potted poppy decoy. Torches at (7,0,4) and (8,0,4) guide toward building. Lanterns at (3,0,0) and (0,0,3) mark central area. Air fill to y=15 removes natural trees within 15-block radius.
